audit_note: Run/source associations are derived from actual retained source-before/source-after pins. native-first.json is an incomplete real runner record with no pid, exit, or native report; no successful execution is claimed. Failed complete runs remain retained. The builder does not create terminal receipts or run product/build/native commands.
exclusions: Executable bytes and Cargo targets; copied/executed runtime bytes are hash-guarded only.
Native report.html duplicates, unselected PNG sequences and native replay project trees except the exact project files explicitly listed as retained extras.
Foreign fuzz/Cargo.lock and .claude content; current mutable documentation is not snapshotted.

limits.decoded: Bounded gzip-decoded payload bytes plus identity payloads and all metadata; no nested archives.
limits.multimedia: PNG bytes are retained screenshots, not a bound on decoded raster expansion.
limits.raw: Unique retained input bytes plus all metadata.
limits.stored: All published bytes including inventory and other metadata.
